headline: Apple-OpenAI Judge Says He’s ‘Likely’ to Side With iPhone Maker
summary: The judge in Apple Inc.’s high-stakes trade-secret theft case against OpenAI said he’s “highly likely” to grant the iPhone maker an injunction barring use of its proprietary information by former employees now at the artificial intelligence startup.
title: Apple-OpenAI Judge Says He’s ‘Likely’ to Side With iPhone Maker
